jobs.description_text:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking an experienced Welder to join our team in McHenry, MS. As a Machinist, you will play a crucial role in the production of precision components and parts for the programmatic and commissioning efforts at Anduril Rocket Motor Systems. Your responsibilities will encompass a wide array of tasks, primarily focused on welding, cutting, and general fabrication of diverse metals, alloys, and non-metallic materials.

WHAT YOU'LL DO: 

  • Utilize welding techniques to assemble components, ensuring precision and adherence to specifications. (GMAW/MIG, GTAW/TIG, SMAW, & FCAW)
  • Perform cutting and machining operations on various materials to fabricate intricate parts.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cobalt
jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Tubi's native app runtime for connected TVs on Cobalt, the lightweight, open-source browser engine behind YouTube on living room devices. You will own the layer between Tubi's React app and the device: the Cobalt engine, its Starboard porting layer, and new native components we write in C++ and Rust.

The goal is a Tubi app that launches faster, uses less memory, and behaves the same on every device, starting with Fire TV and expanding to other CTV platforms. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role on a small team, working closely with our web engineers, QA, and device partners.

This is a hybrid role which is two days in the SF office. 

What You'll Do:

  • Build, integrate, and ship Cobalt as the runtime for Tubi's CTV apps, packaged as a native library inside our Android (Fire TV) app and later on other platforms
  • Implement and maintain Starboard platform integrations: graphics, input, audio/video playback, DRM, and system services
  • Write new native modules in modern C++ and Rust, including safe FFI boundaries between the two
  • Drive startup and memory performance on low-end, memory-constrained devices (1 GB RAM class): profile, measure, and fix
  • Keep us current with upstream Cobalt releases, track and contribute fixes upstream, and manage security patches for the engine we ship
  • Work with media

You will execute testing campaigns, analyze data, improve existing evaluation capability and refine designs for reliability and vehicle operations.

This role demands technical expertise, strong autonomy, and the ability to align teams and projects to achieve program goals.

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley.
